description:
The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2021. 

This initiative aims to enhance the skill sets of the youth in India. 

The program is designed to address the growing need for skilled labor in various sectors. 

It is particularly focused on empowering marginalized communities and underprivileged sections of society. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort to promote employment and entrepreneurship among the youth. 

The primary objective of the Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is to provide vocational training. 

The government aims to train over 1 million individuals by the end of 2025. 

The program seeks to achieve a minimum placement rate of 70 percent for trained individuals. 

It also aims to improve the employability of participants through skill enhancement. 

The scheme targets various sectors including manufacturing, services, and agriculture. 

Participants will receive training in both technical and soft skills. 

The benefits of the scheme include free vocational training. 

Participants will also receive a stipend of INR 3,000 per month during the training period. 

Upon successful completion of the training, individuals will receive a certificate. 

This certificate is recognized by various industries and employers. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme are as follows. 

Applicants must be between the ages of 18 and 35 years. 

They must belong to economically weaker sections of society. 

An annual family income limit of INR 3 lakh is set for eligibility. 

Educational qualifications are not strictly defined. 

However, preference is given to individuals who have completed at least the 10th grade. 

The application process for the Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is straightforward. 

Interested candidates can apply online through the official government portal. 

The application form requires basic personal information and educational details. 

Candidates must upload documents such as proof of identity and income certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

Successful applicants will receive an acknowledgment and further instructions. 

Training sessions are scheduled to begin quarterly. 

The first batch of training commenced in January 2022. 

Subsequent batches are planned for April, July, and October each year. 

Training centers are established in various states across India. 

These centers are equipped with modern facilities and experienced trainers. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The ministry collaborates with various state governments and training institutes. 

Contact details for inquiries are available on the official website of the Ministry. 

The scheme also includes provisions for monitoring and evaluation. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure quality training and placement. 

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the program. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is part of the larger Skill India initiative. 

This initiative aims to train over 400 million people by 2022. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10,000 crore for skill development programs. 

The scheme is expected to contribute significantly to reducing unemployment rates. 

According to the Ministry of Labour and Employment, the unemployment rate in India was 6.1 percent in 2018. 

The government aims to bring this down to below 4 percent through various employment schemes. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is a crucial step in achieving this goal. 

The program also promotes entrepreneurship among the youth. 

It includes modules on business development and financial literacy. 

Participants are encouraged to start their own ventures post-training. 

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all. 

Special provisions are made for women and differently-abled individuals. 

Women participants are encouraged through additional support and mentorship. 

The government aims for at least 50 percent of the beneficiaries to be women. 

This aligns with the national objective of women empowerment. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is expected to create a skilled workforce. 

This workforce will be essential for the growth of various industries in India. 

The scheme also aims to bridge the skill gap in the labor market. 

According to a report by the National Skill Development Corporation, there is a significant shortage of skilled labor in sectors like construction and IT. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme addresses this gap directly. 

It provides a structured approach to skill development. 

The program also emphasizes the importance of soft skills. 

Communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills are integrated into the training modules. 

This holistic approach ensures that participants are job-ready. 

The government is committed to continuous improvement of the scheme. 

Regular updates and revisions to the training curriculum are made based on industry needs. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme is a vital part of India's economic strategy. 

It aims to foster a culture of skill development and lifelong learning. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the socio-economic conditions of the beneficiaries. 

By 2025, the government aims to have a significant number of skilled individuals contributing to the economy. 

This initiative is a step towards achieving sustainable development goals. 

The Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development scheme reflects the government's commitment to empowering the youth. 

It is a comprehensive program designed to create opportunities for all. 

The scheme is a testament to India's focus on skill development as a pathway to economic growth.
